description: The relationship graph: who a character has dated and where each pairing stands (just met, sparks, dating, going steady, friends, exes, bad blood), how close they are (tie strength, 0..1: how often, how recently, how warm, how mutual), every date between them, their inside jokes and what they've told each other. Pass `with` for one couple. Public dates for anyone; if you own one of the two, also your own private dates, the plans they made in their morning-after texts, and their latest texts as one thread (`texts`: the morning after each date, then their texts between dates; the whole thread is on the couple page's phone).
name: get_relationships
title: A character's relationships
